Built full-stack web applications including Zenvest and StaySphere utilizing Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, implementing secure authentication and server-side request validation.

kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to apply for the Backend Developer (Python Intern) role at shiryam. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your server-side logic and data interchange development. During my professional experience as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Sunflower Trip, I built production-ready systems using Node.js, Express, and MySQL, implementing role-based access control and secure authentication workflows. In addition, my project work includes developing robust backend services, RESTful APIs, and managing server-side request validation using Joi schemas in applications like Zenvest and StaySphere. While my primary development background is in JavaScript and Node.js, I also have working experience with Python and am enthusiastic about applying my software engineering fundamentals to backend development in Python. I am glad to see that the role offers remote work options and conversion opportunities to full-time. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my backend experience aligns with your team's needs. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed

screening_answers.why_this_company: Shiryam offers an opportunity to work in a Slack and Asana-focused environment with competitive stipends, remote work options, certificate and letter of recommendation support, and opportunities to convert to a full-time role.
screening_answers.why_this_role: The role focuses on developing server-side logic and managing data interchange between servers and users, which directly aligns with my backend and full-stack project experience building APIs, server-side validation, and database architectures.
screening_answers.why_you: I bring hands-on full-stack development experience from my internship at Sunflower Trip and freelance work, alongside robust backend project experience including Zenvest, StaySphere, and DriftGuard, where I implemented secure authentication, request validation, and database integration.
